title: GLQuake 0.97 for Linux (id Software, November 1997) — its 3dfx OpenGL, drawn by WebGL
author: id Software, port by Dave 'Zoid' Kirsch
notes: id's GLQuake 0.97 for Linux, written for a 3dfx Voodoo: its libMesaGL.so.2 (Mesa on Glide, with fxMesa's full-screen calls) is made in JavaScript by MIRAGE (src/hle/fxmesa.js), its OpenGL drawn by PRISM's gl.js on WebGL2; its keyboard and mouse are Debian 1.3's svgalib, as on a 1997 PC. pak0.pak is quake106.zip's shareware episode.
licenseName: id Software's shareware licence (SLICNSE.TXT, June 1996), as quake106.zip carries it
caution: Quake's shareware episode is id Software's, under its shareware licence, not a free one: it may be played and passed on whole and free of charge, with the licence, and not used commercially or displayed publicly. MIRAGE never copies it: the page fetches quake106.zip from idgames, unchanged, the licence inside it.
